items.title: Firefox 152 puts an AI assistant and one-tap site shortcuts in your browser — free at firefox.com
items.summary: Update free at firefox.com or via the in-app updater (Menu > Help > About Firefox). Firefox 152's new 'Smart Window' summarizes and explains any text you select using a built-in assistant.

items.title: Signal is the free messaging app that encrypts every text and call — get it at signal.org
items.summary: Install Signal free from signal.org or your phone's app store. It's open-source and end-to-end encrypts your texts, calls, and photos so not even Signal can read them.

items.title: A 5 Raspberry Pi 5 is a real desktop and project computer that fits in your palm
items.summary: Buy a Raspberry Pi 5 for 5 at raspberrypi.com or Amazon and boot Raspberry Pi OS from a microSD card. It runs a full Linux desktop — perfect for a kid's first PC or smart-home hub.

items.title: Chat with AI privately in your own browser — Open WebUI is the free local tool at openwebui.com
items.summary: Install Open WebUI free from openwebui.com and pair it with Ollama to run AI models on your own PC so your chats never leave the house. No subscription, no cloud.

items.title: Stop fighting codecs — VLC plays any video or audio file free at videolan.org
items.summary: Download VLC free at videolan.org. It opens every video and music format — MP4, MKV, AVI, FLAC — without hunting for a 'codec pack.' No ads, no popups.
